requirements.title: User Authentication & Session Management
requirements.text: User Authentication & Session Management. The system must provide a secure user authentication mechanism that validates credentials against stored hashed passwords and issues a signed JWT access token with a configurable expiry time. All authenticated sessions must be uniquely identifiable via a session_id field returned in the authentication response, enabling session revocation and audit trail generation.

requirements.title: Product Catalogue Retrieval
requirements.text: Product Catalogue Retrieval. The system must expose a paginated endpoint to retrieve the full product catalogue, supporting filtering by keyword, category, and price range. Each product record in the response must include the product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and at least one associated image_url. The endpoint must accept pagination parameters (page and page_size) to control result volume.

requirements.title: Shopping Cart Management
requirements.text: Shopping Cart Management. The system must allow authenticated users to add, update quantity, and remove individual items from a persistent shopping cart. Every cart state response must include the full list of cart items with their item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and a server-computed subtotal reflecting the current cart total. Cart state must persist across user sessions.

requirements.title: Refund Transaction Integrity
requirements.text: Refund Transaction Integrity. All refund transactions must include a unique, client-provided transaction_id field in the request body to enable idempotent processing and financial audit compliance. This transaction_id must also appear in the refund receipt returned in the API response, ensuring end-to-end traceability of every refund operation initiated by the client system.

requirements.title: Checkout & Order Placement
requirements.text: Checkout & Order Placement. The checkout endpoint must accept a complete order payload including the user's cart contents, a validated shipping_address object, a selected delivery_method, and a payment_method_token. Upon successful order placement, the API must return a unique order_id and an estimated_delivery_date. The endpoint must reject incomplete payloads with a structured validation error response.

requirements.title: Payment Method Support
requirements.text: Payment Method Support. The system must support multiple payment methods including credit and debit card payments (via card_token), digital wallet payments through Apple Pay (via apple_pay_token) and Google Pay (via google_pay_token), and previously stored payment instruments (via saved_payment_id). The payment_type field must be explicitly declared in every payment processing request to identify the method being used.

requirements.title: Order Status Tracking
requirements.text: Order Status Tracking. The system must provide an authenticated endpoint that accepts an order_id and returns the real-time fulfilment status of that order. The status response must include a status_label field and an array of timeline_events, each with a stage name (order_placed, processing, dispatched, out_for_delivery, delivered) and its corresponding ISO 8601 timestamp. Orders that do not belong to the authenticated user must return a 403 Forbidden response.

requirements.title: User Profile Management
requirements.text: User Profile Management. Authenticated users must be able to retrieve and update their profile information via dedicated GET and PUT endpoints. Updatable fields must include display_name, email, shipping_addresses (an array), and notification_preferences. Any request to change the email field must set an email_verification_pending flag in the response, indicating that a re-verification workflow has been triggered.

requirements.title: Two-Factor Authentication Enforcement
requirements.text: Two-Factor Authentication Enforcement. All high-value operations — defined as orders with a total value exceeding $500 or first-time registration of a new payment method — must require Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) verification before the operation is permitted to proceed. The system must expose a dedicated 2fa/challenge endpoint to issue a time-limited OTP, and a 2fa/verify endpoint to validate the user's submitted code before the primary operation is authorised.

requirements.title: Notification Subscription Management
requirements.text: Notification Subscription Management. The system must allow authenticated users to retrieve and modify their notification preferences via dedicated endpoints. Subscribable notification categories must include order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts. Preference changes must be persisted immediately and honoured by all downstream messaging services. The response must confirm the updated preference state for each category.
